get.description:
Retrieve vacant duties within a specified date range. Allows filtering by grade type category, grade type, and grade. Supports retrieval of duties from the past 7 years for historical corrections. Returns detailed duty information including current state and relevant attributes for vacant duty identification.

**Usage:**
- Path: `/{tenant}/duties` (e.g., `/nswh/duties`)
- Mandatory: tenant (path), resourcingOrgUnitId, fromDate, toDate
- Optional filters: vacantDutyGradeTypeCategory, vacantDutyGradeType, vacantDutyGrade
- Maximum date range: 7 years for historical data

**Example queries:**
- `GET /nswh/duties?resourcingOrgUnitId=12345&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`
- `GET /nswh/duties?resourcingOrgUnitId=12345&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31&vacantDutyGradeType=2`

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Tenant identifier for the API endpoint

parameters.name: resourcingOrgUnitId
parameters.description: Resourcing Organisation Unit ID (mandatory)

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (mandatory)

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (mandatory)

parameters.name: vacantDutyGradeTypeCategoryId
parameters.description: Vacant Duty Grade Type Category ID - filter by specific grade type category (optional)

parameters.name: vacantDutyGradeTypeId
parameters.description: Vacant Duty Grade Type ID - filter by specific grade type (optional)

parameters.name: vacantDutyGradeId
parameters.description: Vacant Duty Grade ID - filter by specific grade (optional)

400.description: Bad Request - Missing mandatory parameters or invalid parameter format

hint.description: Helpful hint for resolving the error
hint.example: Refer to documentation to check required parameters or parameters allowed type and length

404.description: Not Found - No vacant duties found matching the criteria

message.example: No vacant duties found for the specified criteria

get.description:
Retrieve assigned duties for a given Posting, Person, or Org Unit within a specified date range. Supports filtering by various parameters including duty assignment ID, assignment number, person ID, and org unit ID. Returns detailed duty assignment information including actual times, fulfillment details, and cancellation status.

**Query Scenarios:**

**Path:** `/{tenant}/duty-assignments` (e.g., `/nswh/duty-assignments`)

**Scenario 1:** Direct lookup by Duty Assignment ID
- `GET /nswh/duty-assignments?dutyAssignmentId=78901` (standalone)

**Scenario 2:** Query by Assignment Number + Date Range (max 8 weeks)
- `GET /nswh/duty-assignments?assignmentNumber=ASN-001-2024&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`

**Scenario 3:** Query by Person ID + Date Range (max 8 weeks)
- `GET /nswh/duty-assignments?personId=67890&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`

**Scenario 4:** Query by Org Unit ID + Date Range (max 2 weeks)
- `GET /nswh/duty-assignments?owningOrgUnitId=54321&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-14`

**Optional Filters** (can be combined with any scenario):
- `activeOnly=true` - Include only non-cancelled duties
- `resourcingOrgUnitId=98765` - Filter by resourcing org unit
- `dutyId=11111` - Filter by specific duty
- `fulfillmentCategory=Mandatory` - Filter by fulfillment category

parameters.description: Tenant identifier for the API endpoint

parameters.name: dutyAssignmentId
parameters.description: Duty Assignment ID (optional - can be used standalone)

parameters.name: assignmentNumber
parameters.description: Assignment Number (optional - requires fromDate and toDate, max 8 weeks)

parameters.name: personId
parameters.description: Person ID (optional - requires fromDate and toDate, max 8 weeks)

parameters.name: owningOrgUnitId
parameters.description: Owning Organisation Unit ID (optional - requires fromDate and toDate, max 2 weeks)

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (required when using assignmentNumber, personId, or owningOrgUnitId)

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (required when using assignmentNumber, personId, or owningOrgUnitId)

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: Include only active (non-cancelled) duties (optional)

parameters.name: resourcingOrgUnitId
parameters.description: Resourcing Organisation Unit ID - filter by specific resourcing org unit (optional)

parameters.name: dutyId
parameters.description: Duty ID - filter by specific duty (optional)

parameters.name: fulfillmentCategory
parameters.description: Fulfillment Category - filter by specific category (optional, values: Optional, Mandatory, Additional, Stub)

get.description:
Retrieve roster data for employees within Optima system. Returns comprehensive roster information including employee details, organizational structure, shift information, and timing data. At least one of PersonId or UnitId must be provided. Date range is optional - if not provided, defaults to 4 weeks from current date.

**Usage Examples:**
- `GET /{tenant}/duties/roster-data?personId=12345`
- `GET /{tenant}/duties/roster-data?unitId=67890&from=2024-01-01&to=2024-01-31`
- `GET /{tenant}/duties/roster-data?personId=12345&from=2024-01-01&to=2024-01-31`

parameters.description: End date for roster data in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional - defaults to 4 weeks from current date)

get.description:
Retrieve posting information for workers within a specified date range. Supports filtering by assignment number, person ID, or org unit ID. Returns detailed posting information including posting details, assignment information, and worker data.

**Query Scenarios:**

**Path:** `/{tenant}/postings` (e.g., `/nswh/postings`)

**Scenario 1:** Query by Assignment Number + Date Range
- `GET /nswh/postings?assignmentNumber=ASN-001-2024&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`

**Scenario 2:** Query by Person ID + Date Range
- `GET /nswh/postings?personId=67890&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`

**Scenario 3:** Query by Org Unit ID + Date Range
- `GET /nswh/postings?orgUnitId=54321&fromDate=2024-01-01&toDate=2024-01-31`

**Note:** You must provide either assignmentNumber, personId, or orgUnitId along with fromDate and toDate.
